text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The entry sheet for the upcoming 
selection race has been posted. Make sure 
to check it if you've registered."
choice_data_list: (Ah, is it that time of year already?)

text_block_list.text:
"I need to make sure I check out the next 
generation, too. As I jot down notes on 
the races to watch..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm with that girl again... Will I lose 
again? My debut... Is it hopeless after 
all...?

She was an Umamusume I had only just 
jotted down in my notes as one to watch. 
Seeing her so pessimistic about her debut, 
I couldn't just leave her alone.
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true at all.
I don't think that's true.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh!? R-Really...?
choice_data_list:
If you want, mind if I give you a little 
advice?

If you want, can I give you a little 
advice?

text_block_list.text:
For the future of the Twinkle Series, I 
decided to lend just a little bit of my 
help.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... My time really went down...! 
Just from watching the furlong poles while 
running!
choice_data_list: Right, this is how fast you truly are.
Right, this is how fast you truly are.

text_block_list.text:
"'They beat me in the past.' Once you 
remove unnecessary filters like that, the 
world is surprisingly simple."
choice_data_list:
Past glory doesn't prove your strength 
today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
! ...As expected, you really are amazing. 
Just like on that show you did with the 
Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... I know it's presumptuous, but 
please! —Will you be my Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I need you! Someone who isn't bound by 
anything and truly believes in me...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-senpai has both confidence and 
talent. But I'm full of doubts, and I 
can't do it alone... That's why!
choice_data_list:
...Yeah. I understand what you're trying 
to say.

text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume like Sirius Symboli would 
surely achieve what she must, even without 
a Trainer like me—and yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna take the world. In the world's 
skies where no one has ever claimed 
victory before, I'll shine."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I will rewrite this legend soon enough 
with my own legs. Stop clinging to relics 
of the past."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"‘...It is in the darkest nights that the 
stars shine brightest.’"
choice_data_list: Sirius is the one who made me a Trainer
Sirius is the one who made me a Trainer

text_block_list.text:
And right by her side, there is still a 
view I desperately want to see with my own 
eyes. That's why I...
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, but I can't be your Trainer.
I'm sorry, I can't become your Trainer.

text_block_list.text:
"After parting with the Umamusume, while 
preparing for Sirius Symboli's 
training..."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: That was quite a passionate proposal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey. How long do you plan on following me?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just think of it as an open classroom day. 
...Still, what a shame.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And here I was planning to scout you 
myself.
choice_data_list: Ahaha, you're joking again...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Are you joking?

Those deep, calm green eyes that have 
gazed upon turfs across the globe look 
straight at me.

Surely, this must be a tremendous honor. 
And yet, my own heart was... astonishingly 
calm.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Have you gossiped to your heart's 
content?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ain't got time to mess with an old geezer. 
Let's get this started already.
choice_data_list: Ah, right! I'm sorry, excuse me!
Ah, yes! Excuse me, pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, well. Looks like I've been 
turned down."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—...While we're on the subject, let me say 
this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In the grand scheme of things, I am 
complete on my own. Any Trainer will do.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who's beside me, I only have 
one job. It doesn't change a single damn 
thing."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Even having said that, though...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of taking off your 
collar. Nor do I intend to hand your leash 
to anyone else.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get started.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah!
Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
Powering on the tablet in my hands as 
instructed ...a wave of joy slowly welled 
up inside me.

There is just one thing she's mistaken 
about.
choice_data_list:
Still, it's okay to take off the collar, 
you know.

Still, it's okay to take off the collar, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I'll be right by your side anyway.
I'll be right by your side regardless.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. —Good boy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. —Good girl.
